item.title: Man in His 40s Killed in N22 Crash in Kerry
item.description: A man in his 40s has been killed in a crash on the N22 in Kerry. Two cars collided near Dromadeesirt at around twenty to 7 yesterday evening. The man who died was one of the drivers. Advertisement The other driver, a man in his 30s, is being treated in University Hospital Kerry for non-life threatening injuries. Gardaí are appealing for witnesses.

item.title: Status Yellow Weather Warning Issued for County Leitrim This Afternoon
item.description: County Leitrim will be under a status yellow weather warning this afternoon. Met Éireann are advising that there could be some fallen trees and branches and difficult travelling conditions. The alert is in place from 4pm until 10pm this evening. Advertisement The warning also covers Clare, Kerry, Donegal, Galway, Mayo and Sligo.

item.title: Anniversary Mass for County Leitrim Farmer Liam Farrell Takes Place Today
item.description: The anniversary mass of county Leitrim farmer Liam Farrell takes place today. It's being held in St Michael's Church in Bornacoola at 11am. The 87-year-old lived alone in Rooskey and was found dead at the back door of his home on Sunday 13 January 2020. His family believe he may have been attacked. Liam's son Brendan is optimistic the family will learn the cause of his death: Advertisement Anyone with any information regarding the case of Liam Farrell is asked to contact The Cold Case Team.

item.title: Peter Burke wants to be Public Expenditure Minister next year
item.description: Peter Burke says he wants to become the Public Expenditure Minister next year. The Enterprise Minister and Longford-Westmeath TD told The Sunday Times: "I'd love the opportunity to serve in one of the money ministries. I wouldn't hide that absolutely one bit." He says he believes he's "well qualified" for the role. Advertisement Tanaiste Simon Harris is the currently the Finance Minister, taking over from Paschal Donohoe recently when he quit politics, but Harris will become Taoiseach next year

item.title: New men's shed could be in the pipeline for Ballymahon
item.description: A new men's shed could be in the pipeline for Co. Longford this year. A local group has taken the initiative to advocate for a new shed in Ballymahon and are currently gauging interest for the project. Information sessions will be held in Bridgeways Family Resource Centre on January 14th at 7pm, while another meeting will take place in Ballymahon Library on January 21st at 2pm. item.title: Tributes pour in following passing of Longford's first female mayor
item.description: The first female mayor of Longford and former Fine Gael councillor, Maura Kilbride-Harkin, has passed away. She served in the Granard local electoral area from 1985 to 2009, and in 1995 she became the county's first ever female county council chairperson. The long-serving politician was also the only female representative elected to Longford County Council in 1985. item.title: Prayers said for cold-case detectives at Liam Farrell's anniversary Mass
item.description: Prayers were said for the cold-case detectives investigating Liam Farrell’s suspicious death at his anniversary Mass today. item.description: Mayo sailed into the FBD league final after a convincing 13-point win over Roscommon. Mayo scoring a 22 points to 1-6 win to setup a FBD league final meeting with Galway. item.title: Leitrim Councillor Backs Small Business Support Scheme
item.description: A Leitrim councillor says he supports introducing a small business support scheme in the county. Commercial rates increased by 5% in Leitrim for the second consecutive year following the councils budget meeting in November. Fine Gael's Enda McGloin says he would like to see a scheme introduced where the full rates increase wouldn't apply to smaller businesses. item.title: 27,000 people - and almost 4,000 tractors - attended Athlone protest
item.description: Some 27,000 people attended the community protest against the Mercosur trade agreement in Athlone yesterday. 3,845 tractors were also present, in a demonstration organised by Independent Ireland. They were protesting against the trade agreement between the EU and Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay.
